contract: Bind Av1BridgeSetup to an MP4 av01 or dav1 description or a Matroska AV1 track. Frame each packet as one low-overhead temporal unit.

Use an independent whole-file oracle for ISO BMFF sample tables and Matroska SimpleBlocks. Compare the exact bytes of every temporal unit, with a leading Temporal Delimiter OBU and a size field at each OBU, per AV1 §§5.2–5.3 and the AV1 ISO BMFF binding §2.4.
Include the configuration OBUs at random access if the configuration holds a sequence header and the sample lacks one. Preserve complete sample OBUs and their order.
